verses.text: Mamin Jehová, ab' wal jun in lesal tik. In gana to sk'och waw t'ayach.
Manh ach b'at mikan t'ayin ayik ay in och ilk'olal. Elokab' t'a a k'ool ab'an in lesal. Komonok elanhchamel tzach tak'wi t'ayin ayik tzach wawtani.
Wan slajwiem in k 'inal icha wal satem te' tab'. Wan stz'ab'at in b'akil icha te' kuxk'ak' swab'i.
Manhxalaj yip in pixan swab'i, icha wal takinh ank'ultak in tiknaik. Maxtzak ochlaj in wejel.
Ix och lotzan in tz'umal t'a in b'akil yuj b'aj tzin te oq'ui.
Lajan in icha junok nok' kujub' t'a tzinan lu'um, ma icha nok' xoch' b'aj ay te' k'atak pat.
Max ochlaj in wayanh. Lajan in yet' nok' much tzek' sch'okojil t'a chontak pat.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, junjun k'u stzuntzej kus in k'ool heb'. Tzin yak'anpax b'inaj heb' t'a skatab'.
Ichato tik'aq'uil taanh in wael tzin wa''a. Skalej sb'a yal in sat yet' tas swuk'ej.
Yujnhej a k'ak'alk'olal yet' yowal a k'ol t'ayin, ix in ik'ank'e waan, ix lajwi chi' ix in a yumankanb'at t'a najat.
Icha junok enhul wanxo satemi, icha wal chi' in k 'inal. Wan in takjiem icha wal anh ank'ultak swab'i.
Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a masanil tiempo. Ol ach nachajnhejkot t'a masanil k 'inal.
Kotanh, ok'okab' a k'ol t'a Sion. Toxo ix ja stiempoal to tzak'xi a wach'k'olal t'ay.
Ha onh a chekab' onh tik xajan Sion kuuj, wach'chom lanhchajnak emi. Tzonh oq'ui yujto ix jujiemi.
Masanil nakión yet' heb' winh sreyal yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol xiw heb' t'a stzikikial Jehová te b'inajnak.
Ayik ol b'oxik'e Sion, ol sch'oxan sb'a t'a skal stzikikial ta'.
A' ol chaan slesal heb' malaj mach skolwaj yet'ok. Manh ol spatikejel-laj heb', ayik ol yalan sb'a heb' t'ay.
Tz'ib'chajokab'kan t'a yol ch'anh uum tas ol sk'ulok Jehová yik wach' a heb' manto aljoklaj, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ay.
Hato t'a sk'ojnub' Jehová t'a satcha'anh ol yilanemta lum lum tik,
yik wach' ol b'o yaj b'aj stewi heb' presowum. Ol skolankanel heb' winh preso yaji, heb' ayoch chamel t'a yib'anh,
yik ol aljokel yab'ixal t'a Sion, yik tz'alchajpax wach' lolonel t'ay t'a Jerusalén.
Yuj chi' ol ja masanil nakión ul yak'em sb'a t'a Jehová chi'.
Ix yik'anel wip Jehová ayik ayto in k 'inal, ix tzap in k 'inal yuj.
Ix walan t'ay: Ach in Diosal, manh ak' tzap in k 'inal. Ha wal a k 'inal a ach tik, malaj slajwub'.
Atax t'a yichb'anel a b'onakkanem yich yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a ach pax a b'onakkan satcha'anh.

Ol satel masanil juntzanh tik, a hachxo jun, ayachnhejeq'ui. Ha juntzanh tik ol ixtaxok, icha sk'ab'ik'och junok k'apak, ol a k'exkaneli, icha wal sk'exanel junok sk'a pichul heb' anima, syumankaneli.
Ha hachxo jun, hanheja' aji, malaj b'ak'uinh ol ach satelok.
Ha heb' kuninal a onh a chekab' onh tik, junk'olal ol aj heb' t'a ichanh. Yuj a kolwal, malaj tas ol ik'an heb'.
